target.title: fix(tailscale): guard JSON.parse crash in hasTailscaleFunnelRouteForPort
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `hasTailscaleFunnelRouteForPort` would crash with an unhandled `SyntaxError` when tailscale `funnel status --json` returned malformed JSON output. The `parsePossiblyNoisyJsonObject` call on line 295 was outside the try-catch block that only protected the exec call.

This affects health checks, funnel route detection, and route setup — any caller of `hasTailscaleFunnelRouteForPort` would have an uncaught promise rejection instead of graceful degradation.

## Why This Change Was Made

Wrap the `parsePossiblyNoisyJsonObject` call in a separate try-catch that returns `false` (same behavior as the exec-failure path). The other two call sites (`getTailnetHostname` at line 130, `readTailscaleWhoisIdentity` at line 475) were already protected by their own try-catch blocks. This change only widens the existing exec-only catch to also cover the JSON parse.

## User Impact

Prevents unhandled SyntaxError crashes during funnel route health checks when tailscale outputs malformed JSON.

## Evidence

- `src/infra/tailscale.test.ts`: 30/30 passed ✅
- `src/infra/tailnet.test.ts`: 4/4 passed ✅
- Updated test "gracefully handles malformed JSON output" replaces "preserves malformed status parse failures"
- Runtime verification: `grep` confirms all 3 call sites are now guarded
